newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-FTSE to shuffle uneasily between 4735-4775.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-FTSE to shuffle uneasily between 4735-4775.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index will shuffle along on Tuesday trying to arrest a short-term weak trend, technical analysts said.
But the upside may be restricted to around 4,760 to 4,775, they added.

Demoralised investors could still send the index down to 4,720 following an uneasy time on Monday when confidence and cohesion was lost as the index slipped back. But some support at 4,735 may stop the market from dropping too quickly, analysts said.
By 0748 GMT, the FTSE was up 4.7 at 4,749.8.
